_estimation_note: SKELETON / IMAGE+AUDIO-INDEPENDENT. All start/dur values and narrationSeconds are ESTIMATED from span word-count (seconds = words / 2.75 ~= 165 wpm), NOT measured from audio. Body cuts are distributed ~2.2s each across each span's cuts and accumulated in script order. These MUST be re-fit to the real ElevenLabs master narration (whisper-aligned) at assembly, and 'captions' MUST be regenerated from that audio (left [] here on purpose). Image src paths reference PLANNED hero stills (williams/img/PD-2026-036-<heroId>-IMG-001.png under remotion/public/) that do not exist yet. Factory b-roll (kind:'footage') and additional per-scene image variants are injected at the image+factory step (that is why the tyler/hinders reference films carry 340-360 cuts vs the ~300 here); footage_diversity is enforced there, not in this skeleton.
hookLine: A blurry photo. A computer's guess. A knock at your door — arrested for a crime you did not commit.
